entities.name: Theodor Frølich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodor Christian Brun Frølich was a Norwegian physician and Professor of Pediatrics at the University of Oslo. In 1938 he was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering contributions to the study of the treatment of Scurvy and to the development of Vitamin C.

entities.name: Theodor Frølich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodor Christian Brun Frølich was a Norwegian physician and Professor of Pediatrics at the University of Oslo. In 1938 he was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering contributions to the study of the treatment of Scurvy and to the development of Vitamin C.
